skill.description: Plan and operate advanced Claude Flow swarms with topology selection, agent deployment, monitoring, and optimization steps.

skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: The audit confirmed that the skill depends on external CLI execution through `npx claude-flow@alpha`, including workflow scripts that can change local swarm state. Many static findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, MCP examples, documentation links, and internal agent identifiers. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Pin Claude Flow to a reviewed version and require explicit approval before running package commands.
Document which commands spawn agents, write files, reconfigure topology, or train neural patterns before execution.
Add a maximum duration, cleanup trap, and output rotation for continuous metrics collection.
Separate executable examples from prose and label them as review-before-run commands.

semantic_findings.title: Mutable External Package Execution
semantic_findings.description: The workflow repeatedly instructs users to execute `npx claude-flow@alpha`. The `@alpha` tag is mutable and can fetch package code at runtime.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both locations show direct `npx claude-flow@alpha` commands. This is legitimate for the skill, but unpinned runtime package execution is a supply-chain risk.

semantic_findings.title: Unbounded Background Metrics Loop
semantic_findings.description: The process guide starts an infinite background loop that appends metrics files every 30 seconds. This can leave background work running and consume disk space.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited block uses `while true` and backgrounds the loop. The impact is operational resource use, not data exfiltration.

content.value_statement: Complex multi-agent workflows can stall when topology, roles, and metrics are unclear. This skill gives structured Claude Flow steps for adaptive swarm coordination.
actual_capabilities: Guides initialization for hierarchical, mesh, and adaptive Claude Flow swarms.
Shows CLI and MCP patterns for spawning coordinators and agents.
Explains topology selection for delegation, peer work, pipelines, and variable workloads.
Defines monitoring, metrics export, bottleneck analysis, and report generation steps.
Describes dynamic reconfiguration, scaling, rebalancing, and neural training workflows.
Includes validation checklists, success metrics, and troubleshooting guidance.
limitations: Requires Claude Flow to be installed and configured before use.
Uses alpha package examples, so users should pin and review versions.
Does not prove that claimed performance gains are real in every environment.
Does not replace production monitoring, access control, or release governance.

use_cases.title: Plan a multi-agent build workflow
use_cases.description: Select a topology, define coordinator roles, and create validation checks before running agents.

use_cases.title: Tune swarm performance
use_cases.description: Collect baseline metrics, identify bottlenecks, and choose rebalancing or topology changes.

use_cases.title: Document coordination patterns
use_cases.description: Turn swarm setup, monitoring, and optimization steps into a repeatable operating procedure.

prompt_templates.title: Initialize a basic swarm
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a known project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to initialize a hierarchical Claude Flow swarm for a coding project. Give me the setup steps and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the right topology
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to choose between hierarchical, mesh, star, ring, and adaptive topologies for my task. Explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a slow swarm
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to monitor a running swarm, identify bottlenecks, and propose safe topology changes before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Design adaptive optimization
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design an adaptive swarm optimization plan with metrics, rollback checks, and explicit command approval gates.

output_examples.input: Initialize an adaptive swarm for a complex refactor.
output_examples.output: A staged plan that selects topology, lists coordinator roles, defines validation checks, and asks before running external commands.

output_examples.input: My swarm has high latency and uneven agent usage.
output_examples.output: A diagnostic path that collects baseline metrics, checks for coordinator bottlenecks, recommends rebalancing, and compares results after changes.

output_examples.input: Create an operating procedure for swarm monitoring.
output_examples.output: A repeatable monitoring checklist with metrics to collect, report sections to prepare, and safe points for topology changes.

best_practices: Pin Claude Flow versions and review commands before execution.
Start with a simple topology, then measure before changing it.
Record baseline metrics before scaling, rebalancing, or training.
anti_patterns: Running mutable alpha package commands without approval or review.
Changing topology during active work without draining tasks first.
Assuming performance improved without comparing baseline and current metrics.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: It provides command examples. Users or agents should request approval before running external commands.

faq.question: What tools are required?
faq.answer: The workflow expects Claude Flow and, for MCP examples, a configured Claude Flow MCP server.

faq.question: Which topology should I start with?
faq.answer: Start with hierarchical for clear delegation, mesh for peer work, or adaptive for changing workloads.

faq.question: Can it improve performance by itself?
faq.answer: No. It gives monitoring and optimization steps, but results depend on workload, configuration, and measurement quality.

faq.question: Is it safe for production?
faq.answer: Use it with review, pinned dependencies, dry runs, and rollback checks before production changes.

faq.question: Does it support Codex and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support. The workflow examples focus on Claude Flow.
